offering_description.value: Uniti builds and operates fiber networks that deliver broadband to households and businesses, dedicated connectivity to enterprises and government organizations, and wholesale capacity to carriers, cloud providers and content companies. It also provides managed cloud networking, security, hosted voice and collaboration services to businesses.

quotes.quote: Uniti is a premier insurgent fiber provider dedicated to enabling mission-critical connectivity across the United States. We build, operate, and deliver fast and reliable communications services, empowering more than a million consumers and businesses in the digital economy.

Michael Flannery is Executive Vice President & President of Uniti Solutions & Kinetic Business, where he leads the company’s business to business organization focused on delivering a full suite of innovative industry-leading and scalable managed cloud networking, collaboration and security solutions that power business transformation.
